profile.headline: Software Engineer at Apple
profile.summary:
Software engineer with a strong background in web development and considerable experience in a wide variety of programming positions and engineering challenges.

I currently work as a software engineer for Apple, out of their Cupertino, CA headquarters.

I possess a Bachelor of Science degree in Computer Engineering from the University of Miami, where I maintained a 3.5 GPA. Throughout my undergraduate career I took on several engineering- and programming-related internships with organizations such as the NASA Goddard Space Flight Center and the satellite services provider known as Intelsat.

I have a breadth of experience with common programming languages including C/C++ and Java, as well as extensive end-to-end web development experience, with work in JavaScript/jQuery AngularJS, HTML5 and CSS3 with Bootstrap, and back-end development using PHP and Spring with Hibernate. I have exhaustive experience with SQL database querying, design and management along with moderate experience with NoSQL databases, particularly MongoDB. I have programmed extensively on Linux, Windows and OS X operating systems. I am very experienced in Ruby and Ruby on Rails, and knowledgeable of other scripting languages as well.

Additionally, my education in computer engineering has given me a sound understanding of electrical engineering principles and various aspects of computer architecture, processor builds, and analog/digital circuit design. Though my interests trend primarily towards software engineering and development, I am open to work in the field of embedded systems, electronics, and other areas more closely linked with electrical engineering.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:

• Researched methods of acoustic and language modeling for optimal speech recognition

positions.title: Customer Solutions Engineering Intern
positions.description:

• Aided in testing and debugging for Excel VBA tool allowing customers to view and update their own services

positions.title: Capacity Management Intern
positions.description: Utilized engineering principles and high-level mathematics to  optimize power and antenna performance for satellites on Intelsat's international fleet; created a manual for future employees.

positions.title: Programming Intern
positions.description:
• Created a C++ program to read data files generated by a prototype satellite and output formatted data to a plotting tool, to aid in debugging for scheduled 2013 launch
• Researched satellite technologies involving movement of satellites in orbit

projects.title: SoundBrush Android Application
projects.description:
SoundBrush is an interactive painting and audio playback application for android operating systems 2.2 and up. Users can color in pre-outlined images or paint on a blank canvas for more visual freedom.

This app was created as part of a 24-hour "Hack-a-thon" hosted at the University of Miami.
